items.name: COMP_LIMITS

source.origin: imported as strip-dynamics-limits.ts COMP_LIMITS ({"thresholdDb":{"min":-60,"max":0,"step":1,"unit":"dB","default":-18,"defaultFrom":"desk"},"ratio":{"min":1,"max":20,"step":0.5,"unit":"","default":4,"defaultFrom":"desk"},"kneeDb":{"min":0,"max":24,"step":0.5,"unit":"dB","default":6,"defaultFrom":"desk"},"attackMs":{"min":0.1,"max":100,"step":1,"unit":"ms","default":5,"defaultFrom":"desk"},"releaseMs":{"min":5,"max":3000,"step":10,"unit":"ms","default":200,"defaultFrom":"desk"},"makeupDb":{"min":0,"max":24,"step":0.5,"unit":"dB","default":0,"defaultFrom":"desk"},"mixPct":{"min":0,"max":100,"step":5,"unit":"%","default":100,"defaultFrom":"desk"}}) at the console engine's 964a79835692; moved in omx-dsp 09ff9da: a travel's step must reach its maximum and default from its minimum

items.doc: The legal range of each compressor field (engineering units). The widget clamps drags to these, `normalizeComp` enforces them, the row's codec refuses by them and the travel sheet publishes them. `default`/`defaultFrom` are the come-up values `defaultCompState` seeds a fresh strip with, read BACK from here rather than restated there.

items.name: PROGRAM_RELEASE

source.origin: imported as strip-dynamics-limits.ts PROGRAM_RELEASE ({"chargeMs":1000,"dischargeMs":5000,"profiles":{"opto":{"fastMs":70,"slowMinMs":110,"slowMaxMs":1100,"share":0.5}}}) at the console engine's 964a79835692; moved in omx-dsp b5bfafe: the release mode became fixed, opto or auto, and auto took its own profile (FX-12, #188)

items.doc: The program-dependent release's model constants — the LA-2A's opto cell as DATA. `chargeMs`/`dischargeMs` are the word's memory constants, shared by every profile; each profile's `fastMs`, `slowMinMs`, `slowMaxMs` and `share` fit the unit's published two-stage recovery. Not operator controls: generated into `omx_contract_limits.h` as `OMX_PROGRAM_RELEASE_*`, which libomxdsp's `omx_env_program_release` reads.

items.name: COMP_KINDS

source.origin: the console engine's compressor kinds (limiter -> peak, comp -> rms); omx-dsp a624f26 include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dynamics_instance.h:84 the rms argument

items.doc: The compressor's character, which picks its detector: `comp` runs the RMS detector, `limiter` the peak detector. The console's comp row carries it (`CompState.kind`, `COMP_KINDS`) and comes up as `comp`.

items.name: DETECTOR_OVERSAMPLINGS

source.origin: the console engine's detector oversampling choices (auto, off, 4x), defaulting to auto; omx-dsp a624f26 include/omxdsp/omx_dyn.h:46-50 OMX_DYN_OVS_AUTO 0, _OFF 1, _X4 2, fx/omx_dynamics_instance.h:84 ovs_mode

items.doc: The compressor's detector oversampling: `auto` runs the control path at 4x only while the attack is faster than DETECTOR_OVERSAMPLE_AUTO_MS, `off` never, `4x` always (omx-dsp's OMX_DYN_OVS_AUTO, _OFF and _X4, in that order, so the index mapping holds). The ids are the console's wire vocabulary (`CompState.detectorOversampling`, what the dynamics row's OPTIONS publishes and a session stores), so the console re-exports this set; it comes up `auto`.

items.name: DETECTOR_TOPOLOGY

source.origin: omx-dsp 91beb6d (lane/salvage-ssl-bus-comp) include/omxdsp/omx_dyn.h:60-68 OMX_DYN_TOPOLOGY_FEEDFORWARD 0, OMX_DYN_TOPOLOGY_FEEDBACK 1, the comp row's detectorTopology (the SSL bus compressor design); :86 a zeroed atom is feedforward

items.doc: Where the compressor's detector listens: `feedforward` hears the slot's input (or its key), `feedback` hears the slot's own pre-make-up output DYN_FB_LOOP_DELAY_SAMPLES late, through one envelope stage, and a keyed slot stays feed-forward (omx-dsp's OMX_DYN_TOPOLOGY_FEEDFORWARD 0 and _FEEDBACK 1, in that order; the set is named for its control, so C spells them OMX_DETECTOR_TOPOLOGY_*). The console's comp row carries it (`detectorTopology`) and comes up `feedforward`, so a zeroed atom is the compressor every slot runs.

items.name: DETECTOR_OVERSAMPLE_LATENCY_SAMPLES

source.origin: omx-dsp 0f23bed include/omxdsp/omx_oversampler.h:151 OMX_OVS_LATENCY_4X 72; the console engine's DETECTOR_OVERSAMPLE_LATENCY_SAMPLES

items.doc: What the 4x detector oversampling costs the strip it is engaged on, in samples: the causal linear-phase half-band's reach, by which the audio is delayed so the gain still lands on the sample it was computed from. A sample count, not a time: the same at every rate. omx-dsp's oversampler declares the same number as OMX_OVS_LATENCY_4X, and its comp and gate faces report it while 4x is engaged.

items.name: COMP_KEY_SOURCES

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#key_src

items.doc: Where the compressor's detector listens: its own input (self), or the key handed to its sidechain port (sidechain), in the order of the integer the key port carries; the gate's keySource ids. Which strip or bus feeds the sidechain is console routing. It comes up self.

items.name: COMP_KEY_HP_HZ_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#hp

items.doc: The key filter's high-pass corner, Hz: the gate's key filter (one Butterworth section, in double), on what the detector hears and never on the audio. 0 is out, the come-up value, and the compressor is the one without it, bit for bit.

items.name: COMP_KEY_LP_HZ_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#lp

items.doc: The key filter's low-pass corner, Hz, after the high-pass. 0 is out, the come-up value.

items.name: COMP_KEY_TILT_DB_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#tilt_slope

items.doc: The key's tilt, in dB per octave at KEY_TILT_PIVOT_HZ: positive brightens what the detector hears, negative darkens it (omx_tilt, a first-order shelf pair about the pivot, after the key filter). 0 is flat, the come-up value, bit for bit.

items.name: COMP_KEY_LISTENS

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#lis

items.doc: While on, the output is what the detector hears, the key after its filter and tilt, folded as detectLink folds it: linked the two legs, mid the mid on both, side the side on both, max the mid on the left and the side on the right. The compressor keeps running underneath. It comes up off.

items.name: COMP_HOLD_MS_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#hold

items.doc: The hold, ms: the detector is frozen this long after its level last rose, so the reduction holds before the release runs. 0 is no hold, the come-up value.

items.name: COMP_DETECT_LINKS

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#link_fold

items.doc: How the detector folds the key's two legs into one level, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: linked, the louder leg (the compressor's own detection, the come-up value); mid, the mid (L + R)/2; side, the side (L - R)/2; max, the louder of the mid and the side. One gain serves both legs whatever the fold.

items.name: COMP_DUCKS

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#duck_on

items.doc: The ducker: on, the reduction the key's level asks for is held to rangeDb, so the programme gain is max(rangeDb, the compressor's law at the key's level). It comes up off.

items.name: COMP_RANGE_DB_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#duck_range

items.doc: The ducker's depth, dB: the deepest the programme goes while the key is above the threshold. 0 ducks nothing. Read only while duck is on.

items.name: COMP_RELEASE_MODES

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at b5bfafee3609, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#rel_mode

items.doc: How the compressor releases, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: `fixed`, the detector's release at releaseMs, the compressor that shipped bit for bit and the come-up value; `opto`, the program-dependent release of PROGRAM_RELEASE_PROFILES.opto (an LA-2A's two-stage recovery, slower the longer the cell was driven); `auto`, the same word with PROGRAM_RELEASE_PROFILES.auto (a bus compressor's AUTO position). In opto and auto the detector releases at its attack pole and releaseMs is inert, kept for when fixed returns (omx_env_program_release on the gain, after the gain computer).

items.name: KEY_TILT_PIVOT_HZ

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/comp.json at c208f5f51395, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_comp_instance.h#OMX_COMP_INSTANCE_TILT_PIVOT_HZ

items.doc: Where a key's tilt pivots, Hz: the frequency a tilt leaves at unity while it brightens or darkens what the detector hears. One pivot for every key that tilts.
